subject: GRC headcount approvals & offer bands — FY25 Q4 hires
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: GRC headcount approvals & offer bands — FY25 Q4 hires

Team,

We need to lock approvals for the two GRC/security engineering hires we've discussed for Q4. Attached is a short packet with the headcount request, the recommended comp bands, and the hiring summary from the interviews. High level:

- Role 1: Senior GRC Analyst (IC, compliance-heavy) — proposed band: $145k–165k total comp
- Role 2: Security Engineering (mid-senior) — proposed band: $180k–205k total comp (depending on level/eq)

Ask: can Finance confirm budget for the posted bands and People Ops confirm the offer templates and background-check clauses? Legal — any changes needed to our standard security screens for these roles? Rishi, please confirm the team allocation and urgency (are both hires starting immediately or staggered?).

I've flagged the candidates from the recruiter (Alex Turner) and an internal referral (Priya Desai) — they are next in line if approval is in place. I included a link to the hiring packet and the comp spreadsheet.

Attachments: Headcount_Request_Form_EVH.pdf, CompBands_GRC_2025.xlsx, GRC_Hiring_Summary_Q4.pdf

Thanks — I need an approval decision this week to hit our Q4 onboarding window.

— Evelyn Hart
Director, Security & GRC
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GRC headcount approvals & offer bands — FY25 Q4 hires

Evelyn —

Thanks for the packet. Quick notes from People Ops:

- Comp bands look reasonable relative to market comps we collected in Oct (see CompBands_GRC_2025.xlsx). I recommend setting the initial offer at the 60th percentile for the Senior GRC Analyst to stay competitive.
- For Security Engineering, we should split hires across L4/L5 with clear leveling language in the offer (we can add bump options tied to promotion).
- Background checks: we will run standard tier-2 (employment + criminal + education verification). For candidates with vendor access we will add the contractor security clearance addendum.

Can you confirm if either candidate requires a signing bonus or relocation? If not, we will send offers using the standard templates.

I'll draft the offer letters once Finance confirms budget.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Talent, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GRC headcount approvals & offer bands — FY25 Q4 hires

Evelyn / Neha —

Quick context on allocation: the Senior GRC Analyst will be dedicated to Compliance Programs (SOC 2 gap remediation + vendor assessments) and should be full-time on that work from start. The Security Engineer is earmarked 60% product security (runtime protections) and 40% platform/inference security (integration with Redwood Runtime). We prefer to fill the Analyst first.

On urgency: hiring timeline to onboard by mid-Jan requires we extend offers by 11/18 at the latest. If we miss that, start slips to late Feb.

No signing bonus expected for the analyst; candidate coming from another SaaS company will expect base + eq. The engineering candidate may require a small sign-on (up to $15k) depending on counteroffers.

— Rishi
Sr. Engineering Manager, Security
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Nov 2025 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GRC headcount approvals & offer bands — FY25 Q4 hires

Evelyn —

Finance has reviewed the headcount request and comp bands. We have budget capacity to cover both hires at the proposed midpoint bands provided the engineering hire does not exceed a $15k sign-on and equity allocation stays within the current comp plan. Approvals:

- Headcount: APPROVED (2 FTEs)
- Budget: APPROVED at bands shown, contingent on final offer not exceeding $15k sign-on for Sec Eng and equity within L4/L5 bands.

Please route the finalized offer packages to me (cc finance-approvals@redwoodinference.com) and copy Neha. We will provide a quick sign-off within 24 business hours.

Vivek
VP Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GRC headcount approvals & offer bands — FY25 Q4 hires

All,

Legal and Security Ops reviewed the candidate packet and the contract language. A few small items to include in the offer:

- Standard background-check consent language + an NDA addendum for anyone with product deep-dive privileges.
- A clause for access provisioning delays — new hires will not receive production keys until cleared by Security Ops.
- For the Senior GRC Analyst, add the clause about vendor assessment ownership in the job description (helps with internal expectation setting).

Neha — once you have the offer letters drafted, send them to me and to security-ops@redwoodinference.com so we can confirm the NDA text. Vivek — finance approval noted; Evelyn, once you confirm candidate selection (Alex's candidate vs. Priya referral), People Ops will prepare the email offer.

Thanks — looks good to proceed.

Laura Bennett
General Counsel, Redwood Inference
